icons.name: Barricade
icons.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE square transparent inventory icon for a grounded survival game, consistent with restrained realistic photographed inventory props. Primary subject: a plain portable improvised wooden barricade, fully assembled, approx 200cm wide, 120cm high, 40cm deep. EXACT construction: THREE broad horizontal medium brown weathered wooden planks, with narrow gaps, mounted across TWO dark gunmetal square-tube upright supports near the ends. Each upright stands on a short fore-aft steel T-foot with a simple triangular brace. The three horizontal planks are the dominant silhouette. A few believable round steel bolt heads secure each plank at the two uprights. Slightly imperfect straight board ends, subtle longitudinal wood grain, faint dirt and wear, modest worn metal edges. No dramatic destruction, no barbed wire, no spikes, no warning tape, no crossed X boards, no sandbags. Composition: full single barricade centered with 10% clear margins, elevated near-orthographic front three-quarter view showing the front wooden face and the short metal feet, width runs horizontally. Style: photorealistic neutral studio prop photography, calm natural materials, subdued colors, soft diffuse light upper left and gentle fill, readable at 64px. True transparent alpha background; no scenery, no floor, no shadow outside object, no text, branding, watermark, UI frame, glow, bloom, dramatic rim light, illustration strokes, or fantasy details.

textures.name: BarricadeWoodBaseColor
textures.prompt: Use case: product-mockup material texture. Generate ONE seamless tileable PBR BASE COLOR / ALBEDO texture only, square 1024 by 1024. Flat close-up surface scan of weathered ordinary medium-brown oak wood. Fine believable long wood grain runs horizontally from left to right, with understated natural muted tan/brown tonal variation, occasional small elongated knots, tiny worn grain furrows, modest age and dust. This is the continuous face of ONE broad wood surface, NOT separate boards: no plank seams, no gaps, no borders, no metal, no nails, no text, no logos. Absolutely flat uniform diffuse lighting; no directional shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no perspective, no 3D shape or object. Avoid extreme orange, strong black streaks, overdone cracks, painted or stylized looks. Seamless across left/right and top/bottom edges. Output intended as a realistically subdued wood surface texture in a survival game's barricade.
